Pay Off Loan or Save the Cash?

If you have some money spare each month, it's natural to wonder whether to clear the debt or grow the savings. The answer usually comes down to the two interest rates. Put yours in below and compare them.
blocks.2:
The "Golden Rule" of Finance

Generally, if your loan interest rate is higher than your savings interest rate, you're better off paying down the debt. Paying off a loan that charges 10% works like earning a guaranteed 10% return on your money, and it's tax-free.

Note on Tax: In the UK, basic rate taxpayers can earn £1,000 of savings interest without paying tax on it. That allowance is called the Personal Savings Allowance. Higher rate taxpayers get £500. It's one reason paying off debt often works out even better for higher earners.
